Digital Verification Process Sparks Confusion and Reunions

A digital verification process, identified as SIR verification, has caused confusion among elders in Bengaluru. However, the same process has also led to a reunion between two brothers after 35 years, with their family having previously believed one of them to be dead. The specific details of the SIR verification process and the nature of the confusion it caused were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
